company_name: AMFLO Fluid Systems & Components Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — AMFLO specializes in precision gas supply systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AMFLO Fluid Systems & Components Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of precision gas supply systems, focusing on high-purity gas components essential for semiconductor applications. With nearly 20 years of experience and a strong emphasis on quality control, AMFLO delivers reliable solutions for gas flow control in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: AMFLO is based in the Songjiang District of Shanghai, operating from a 10,000㎡ factory with advanced clean room facilities.
